payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. All deterministic checks pass: archive MD5 verified, split sizes match official PathMNIST (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), image shape 28×28×3 RGB and 9-class schema align with the standard MedMNIST distribution. Data profile confirms modest class imbalance (ratio 1.63), near-identical train/val class proportions, zero blank images, zero duplicate train samples, and 100% profiled/official data fraction. Channel statistics (R≈0.74, G≈0.53, B≈0.71; stds 0.12–0.18) are consistent with H&E-stained histology patches. The identified ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, mucosa vs. adenocarcinoma, lymphocytes vs. debris) are appropriate and well-scoped for 28×28 resolution; they should inform augmentation and evaluation strategy but do not constitute a defect. The test-set OOD characteristic (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is properly documented in the manifest and should be reflected in downstream evaluation reporting. The null llm_model_digest for qwen3.8 (Ollama) is a minor traceability gap that does not affect pipeline determinism; it is noted for the record. No deterministic findings are present. Proceed to the next stage.
